parameters.name: DomainSwitch
parameters.description:
The domain name statistics switch. Valid values:

- on: enables domain name-level statistics.
- off: user-level data. User-level data is collected by default.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of stream pulling in UTC. The interval between StartTime and EndTime must be within 30 days, and EndTime must be later than the current time.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of stream pulling in UTC. The interval between StartTime and EndTime must be within 30 days.
